pain_title: Do any of these situations sound familiar?
pain_body: Most business owners who reach out to me don't have a technical problem. They have a time and trust problem.

pain_2: "I have an idea to automate something in my business, but I don't have the staff or the time to do it."
pain_3: "I asked an agency for a quote and the price seemed excessive for what I actually need."
pain_4: "I already hired someone and they disappeared with the deposit, or delivered something useless."
services_body: I'm not an agency. I'm a real, local person you can call, meet in person, and who responds when you need me. I use artificial intelligence to deliver in days what used to take weeks.

service_2_desc: Sell online without complications. Payments, catalog, orders.
service_3_desc: If you have a process that should be automated, we automate it.
service_4_desc: Videos, images, and copy for your social media. Production without agency costs.
service_5_desc: From idea to printed book. Position yourself as an expert in your industry.
service_6_desc: Eliminate repetitive manual tasks. Your team does what matters.
guarantee_headline: If you're not satisfied with the result, you don't pay.
guarantee_body: It's that simple. I work to earn your trust, not to charge you and disappear.

casos_headline: Vida Digital eliminated 2 months of administrative chaos per trip to China
casos_subtitle: How a ZOFRI importer went from notebooks and Excel to having their business up to date — in real time — without depending on anyone to see it.
casos_challenge_body_1: Pravin Adwani has 25 years in import and export at ZOFRI.
casos_challenge_body_2: Every time he traveled to China, the business kept running. But when he returned, two months of accumulated work were waiting for him.
casos_challenge_body_3: General ledger. Bank accounts. Stock. Sales notes. Customers.
casos_challenge_body_4: Everything on paper. Everything in Excel. Everything mixed together.
casos_challenge_quote: "It was very hard for me to keep up with the general ledger, the bank accounts, the stock, the sales notes, the customers. It was a tremendous mess."
casos_challenge_body_5: And when a wholesale customer asked for a price catalog, preparing it took hours.
casos_solution_body_1: We built a custom application for Vida Digital.
casos_solution_body_2: Not a generic template. Not software from another country that needs to be adapted.
casos_solution_body_3: A tool designed exactly for how Pravin Adwani works: his petty cash, his general ledger, his stock, his customers, his orders to China.
casos_metric_1_desc: Time recovered for sales and growth
casos_metric_2_desc: Catching up after a trip to China
casos_metric_3_desc: Time to prepare a price catalog
casos_testimonial_quote: "It used to cost me a lot. At least two months of work to catch up. Now everything is up to date in real time. Almost three quarters of my work has decreased. Time I can now dedicate to sales."
casos_cta_title: If you run your business in Excel or on paper, you already know how much that disorder is costing you.
casos_cta_subtitle: Tell me how you work. I'll tell you in 24 hours if I can help you.
proof_bridge: I don't sell generic applications. I build the tool your business needs, around how you already work — not the other way around.
proof_title: Two business owners from the Free Trade Zone had digital ideas waiting. This is what happened when I made them real.
proof_body: One had been running his business for years on paper, Excel, and memory. The other needed to control inventory across locations without getting lost. Neither needed more technology. They needed a tool built around how they already worked.
proof_quote_pravin: Almost three quarters of my work has decreased, which I can now dedicate to sales and other things I never had time for.
proof_quote_anil: With Pablo the difference is that I told him how I wanted it, and he modified it my way. That difference felt like a tailor-made suit.
casos_hero_headline_part1: Two Free Trade Zone business owners had a problem.
casos_hero_headline_part2: Today they have their business under control
casos_hero_subtitle: How Vida Digital and Anil Chandani went from notebooks, Excel, and memory to having their business information up to date — in seconds, not months.
casos_case2_challenge_body_1: Anil Chandani runs stores and a warehouse in the Iquique Free Trade Zone, with plenty of merchandise moving through them.
casos_case2_challenge_body_2: He controlled inventory with Excel, paper, and memory. And memory failed.
casos_case2_challenge_body_3: How much of this product is left? Where is it? When was it bought?
casos_case2_challenge_body_4: Sometimes he bought more without knowing he already had stock. Other times he ran out of a product without noticing — and lost the customer.
casos_case2_challenge_quote: "I'm not big on technology, I don't like complicated things. I'd already looked on the App Store, but everything was generic, with complicated sign-up and charges that showed up after the free months."
casos_case2_challenge_body_5: He wanted something simple, built for how he already worked — not one more generic app.
casos_case2_solution_body_1: We built a custom inventory application for Anil.
casos_case2_solution_body_2: No features he didn't need. No complicated sign-up. No hidden charges.
casos_case2_solution_body_3: A tool where he types a product code and instantly sees the photo, cost, movements, and exact location in the warehouse — from his computer or his phone.
casos_case2_metric_1_desc: Checks stock, cost, and location of any product in one click
casos_case2_metric_2_desc: No longer buys more of what he already had in stock
casos_case2_metric_3_desc: He used to lose customers without noticing a product was missing
casos_case2_testimonial_quote: "With Pablo the difference is that I told him how I wanted it, and he modified it my way. That difference felt like a tailor-made suit."
casos_case2_testimonial_attr: Import Export Arjun · Zona Franca, Iquique
videos_hero_title: Publish professional videos without getting stuck editing
videos_hero_subtitle: You send your raw footage and get back edited reels ready to publish. Your first version delivered within a maximum of 48 hours after receiving all the material and instructions.
videos_problem_title: Your time is worth more spent with clients than fighting editing software
videos_problem_subtitle: Most doctors, lawyers, aestheticians and service providers want an active presence on social media. The obstacle is never the camera: it's losing valuable hours cutting silences, fine-tuning subtitles and hunting for royalty-free music.
videos_problem_block1_body: You record a five-minute explanation between appointments, but you end up losing the whole weekend trying filters, syncing subtitles and exporting videos that don't turn out how you imagined.
videos_problem_block2_body: We use the computational speed of AI agents for transcription and selective b-roll, combined with the meticulous review and aesthetic judgment of a professional editor.
videos_problem_block3_body: You take care of your practice, shop or law office without drifting away from what actually generates income. We make sure your raw footage becomes flawless reels that attract new clients.
